history.title: History
about.intro: RepairCenter turns the built-in Windows tools DISM, SFC and chkdsk into one traceable workflow: first find out what is actually needed, then do only that, verify the result and document it properly. A graded maintenance stage tidies up afterwards.
about.what1: Repairs the component store and system files – with an automatic second pass when SFC could not repair everything.
about.what2: Evaluates the result from the CBS log file instead of relying on unreliable exit codes.
about.what3: Graded maintenance: temporary files, WinSxS, update cache, TRIM or defragmentation, network.
about.what4: Every run produces a report, JSON data and a tool log under C:\RepairLogs.
about.notTitle: What it deliberately does not do
about.not1: No registry cleaners, no "RAM optimisers", no tuning tweaks.
about.not2: It never disables services or startup entries on its own – they are only reported.
about.not3: No cloud, no telemetry, no network connection.
